title: Dynamic curve · Print artworks
slide_intent: Compare where to divide a picture with a curve. The edge and depth of the division determine whether the viewer sees an identifier, a headline or more of the athlete.
strategic_value: Red and white masters can connect covers made by different programs while giving the photograph a shape suited to its subject.
demonstration: Two rows compare red and white devices across top, base and half-page treatments. Each column repeats its photograph so the placement change is easy to isolate.
practical_value: Choose a master by the space needed for the mark or copy. Add the program mark separately and retain the white frame for desktop printing.

content_islands.name: Artwork guidance
content_islands.spec: At left explain the available masters, separate transparent marks and framed print area.

content_islands.name: Treatment matrix
content_islands.spec: Arrange six portraits as a two-by-three comparison. Label columns Top, Base and Half. Label the red and white device rows vertically. Reserve the half treatment for the example with report-cover copy.
